compute.scope: Backbone teacher-forced forward, T=S; GEMM main terms only (2*M*N*Q). DSA counted on the eager QK/PV path. No backward, kernel timing, or small elementwise operators.

memory.activation_estimate_kind: Sum of named forward tensors per the workbook dynamic inventory; not measured peak.
memory.cache_scope: Logical populated inference caches: MLA latent KV per layer, Indexer K on Full layers, one in-flight Top-K index.

training_breakdown.note: One logical model copy; per-device numbers assume balanced sharding. Master weights default to 0 (workbook master_weight_bytes assumption) so the 8 bytes/param optimizer state is not double counted. Excludes activation peak, recompute, allocator/quantization metadata and communication overlap.

notes: Hy4-preview 10T is a planning extension, not an official release; dimensions follow the workbook planning assumptions (E=2048, Top-64).
MTP layer excluded from the backbone analysis (workbook D31).
Unsharded model; TP1/PP4/VPP2/EP64/CP1 are informational (workbook B7).
Weights count in BF16-equivalent bytes; logits default to FP32.
Router correction bias counts toward weights but not gradients/optimizer states.
All displayed GiB use 1e9 bytes. JSON carries raw bytes.
